running_costs.name: Automation and hosting
running_costs.text: Automation or hosting (for example n8n or a small cloud server) is billed by the provider.

running_costs.name: Social scheduler
running_costs.text: A social scheduler (for example Buffer), if you want your own account, is billed by that provider.

running_costs.name: Website domain and hosting
running_costs.text: Your domain and hosting are paid by you to the provider and stay in your name.

running_costs.name: Phone and voice AI
running_costs.text: The phone line and voice-AI minutes are billed by the telephony and AI providers.

running_costs.name: Portals and CRM
running_costs.text: Your Zameen, Graana or other portal package and any CRM subscription stay in your name and are paid by you.
